name: Nuevo León

plates.name: Current design (2023)
plates.fact: Nuevo León's current plate, rolled out in 2023, carries the state's 'Nuevo León' wordmark plus the state and national coats of arms.

plates.name: FIFA World Cup 2026 commemorative
plates.fact: Monterrey hosted World Cup matches, and Nuevo León released a limited run of about 40,000 World Cup plates in March 2026, priced the same as regular plates.

plates.name: Drivers with disabilities
plates.fact: About 1,500 people a year get Nuevo León's disability plates, and the first set is free.
